name: Virginia

teen.nightLimit: Permit holders: no driving midnight to 4 a.m. at all (46.2-335 D). Provisional license under 18: no driving midnight to 4 a.m. except to/from work, an adult-supervised school/civic/religious/public activity, with a parent or spouse 18+ beside the driver, or emergency (46.2-334.01 C).
teen.passengerLimit: Permit: no more than one passenger under 21 who is not family (Va. Code 46.2-335 C; the DMV restrictions page says under 18). Provisional license, under 18: one passenger under 21; after the first year, up to three under 21 when going to/from a school-sponsored activity, with a licensed driver 21+ beside the driver, or in an emergency (46.2-334.01 B). Family exempt.
teen.phone: All drivers: no holding a handheld device while driving, except in an emergency or when lawfully parked or stopped (manual p. 24; Va. Code 46.2-818.2: $125 first offense, $250 second or in a work zone). The former total ban for drivers under 18 (hands-free included) was struck from Va. Code 46.2-334.01 by 2021 Sp. Sess. I c. 132; the DMV teen restrictions page still describes it and is out of date.

bac.under21: 0.02 (Va. Code 18.2-266.1; one-year license loss, $500 minimum fine or 50 hours community service)

notes: Handbook: Virginia Driver's Manual (DMV 39), PDF titled 'English April2026', created 2026-04-27. Read 2026-10-09. Printed page = PDF page - 2.

Knowledge exam (manual p. 3, DMV know-exam page): part one 10 sign questions, all must be correct; part two 30 general questions, 24 to pass (80%). questions/pass above are the two parts combined (10+30, 10+24).
Exam languages from the DMV know-exam page (checked 2026-10-09); Tagalog is not offered. Translators not allowed for offered languages (manual p. 3). Oral exams on request.

Under 18 who fail the exam wait 15 full days. After three failures, the classroom part of driver education (or an approved 8-hour manual course, with conditions) is required before retesting (manual p. 3).
Supervisor: licensed driver 21+ beside the learner, or parent/legal guardian, or sibling 18+ (manual p. 31; 46.2-335 A).
Age 18+: hold permit 60 days or complete driver education before the road test (manual p. 4).
Reckless driving: 20 mph or more over the limit, or over 85 mph (manual p. 14; 46.2-862).
Interstate maximum 70 mph where posted (46.2-870); not in the manual.

Move over: change to a non-adjacent lane for stopped emergency vehicles and tow trucks, or slow down if you cannot; lane change also required for stopped vehicles with hazard lights, warning signs or flares (manual p. 16).

Manual is out of date on insurance: it still lists 30/60/20 minimums and the $500 uninsured motor vehicle fee (pp. 29, 34). Current law: 50/100/25 for policies effective on/after 2025-01-01 (46.2-472 B), and registration requires certified insurance with no fee option (46.2-706 A).
Under 18 demerit-point conviction: driver improvement clinic; second: 90-day suspension; third: one-year revocation or until 18 (manual p. 29).
School bus: divided-highway exemption needs a median or barrier (manual p. 15); no question written.
